edits.old: And one base, one topic, one queue and one login are declared, with no monolith base, no foreign topic and no `task` or `timer` table of this service
edits.new:
And one base, one topic, one queue and one login are declared, with no monolith base, no foreign topic and no `task` or `timer` table of this service

  Scenario: C8 Each business rule of section 8 has a conforming and a breaking draft that the baseline checks (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8
    When a conforming draft and a breaking draft are checked for each rule
    Then the conforming draft passes and the breaking draft fails for every rule
    And no rule of section 8 is left without a test case in section 16

  Scenario: C9 A route-start activity that is retried or times out follows its declared values (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the activities of RouteDecisionWorkflow and their declared retry and timeout values
    When a route-start activity is retried or does not finish within its declared timeout
    Then the retry and the timeout are read from the declared values and no retry count or duration is written in the baseline
    And the activity returns no answer that the contract does not allow

  Scenario: C10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the to state and the rule row in force of the baseline
    When a status change that the model does not allow is submitted to the route answer
    Then the change is refused within the error set of C5 and no route start reference is returned
    And no business value is written in the baseline to decide the refusal
